title: Carfax Used Cars Scraper
description: Scrape used car listings from Carfax.com. Provide a start URL or use filters like make, model, price range, and mileage. Extracts detailed vehicle information including VIN, price, mileage, and Carfax reports.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Start scraping from a specific Carfax search URL. If provided, this will be used instead of filters.

vin.title: VIN
vin.description: Optional VIN for direct detail lookup. When set, the actor will try the Helix detail endpoint for that vehicle.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location or ZIP code to search near.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of vehicles
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of vehicles to collect.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: A safety cap on the number of search result pages to visit.

requestTransport.title: Request transport
requestTransport.description: Choose how requests are sent. Auto prefers custom request API locally when configured, Apify Proxy HTTP on cloud, then browser fallback if enabled.

headerProfile.title: Header profile
headerProfile.description: Header set to try for HTTP requests. Auto rotates Firefox, Chrome, mobile web, and mobile app style headers.

customHeadersJson.title: Custom headers JSON
customHeadersJson.description: Optional JSON object merged into request headers, for example {"Authorization":"Bearer ..."}.

requestApiUrlTemplate.title: Custom request API URL
requestApiUrlTemplate.description: Optional external request API endpoint for local or cloud runs. Use {url} placeholder or the actor will append the target URL as a query/body parameter.

requestApiMethod.title: Custom request API method
requestApiMethod.description: HTTP method used when calling the custom request API.

requestApiUrlParam.title: Custom request API URL parameter
requestApiUrlParam.description: Parameter name used when the custom request API expects the target URL as a query or POST JSON field.

requestApiHeadersJson.title: Custom request API headers JSON
requestApiHeadersJson.description: Optional JSON object used as headers for the custom request API itself.

useBrowserFallback.title: Use browser fallback
useBrowserFallback.description: If enabled, the actor falls back to Playwright Firefox when HTTP and custom API strategies do not return vehicle data.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout seconds
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout for HTTP and custom request API calls.

requestDelayMillis.title: Request delay milliseconds
requestDelayMillis.description: Delay between HTTP detail requests to reduce rate limiting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy (residential recommended for Carfax).
